messages:
tori (Design): quick microcopy/a11y thread — noticed an inconsistency in the table row ellipsis menu. visible action reads 'More actions' but the menu items are 'Archive', 'Export', 'Delete'. Screen reader announces 'Open more actions' on the button. :thinking_face:
ben (PM): users in testing thought 'More actions' was a label not a button. might be better to make the ellipsis button affordance explicit like 'Row actions'.
omar (Frontend): implementation detail: the ellipsis is a button with aria-label='More actions'. changing it is trivial, but want to standardize across lists. there are 6 list patterns using the same component.
sam (a11y): accessibility issues: 1) the button aria-label should match the visible affordance and indicate context (e.g., 'Row actions for <model name>'). 2) once an action like 'Export' runs, we need an announcement — currently we render a non-focusable toast that isn't announced. add aria-live polite region for confirmations. 3) avoid vague menu labels; prefer explicit verbs for actions when possible.
tori (Design): proposed copy changes: ellipsis button aria-label -> 'Row actions, opens menu'; tooltip (hover) -> 'Actions'; menu header (optional) -> '<Model name> actions'; action labels -> keep single verb: 'Archive version', 'Export logs', 'Delete version' (danger).
ben (PM): agree on including object in the verbs. add short confirmation microcopy for delete modal: 'Delete version — This permanently removes version X.'
omar (Frontend): will update the component to accept an `aria-label` template and optional `data-object-name` for screen reader string interpolation. will also wire an `aria-live="polite"` region in the page shell and ensure confirmation messages write to it.
sam (a11y): also ensure menu items have clear accessible names and role='menuitem'. after running long exports, update live region with status like 'Export started. We will notify you when ready.' avoid setting focus to the live region.
tori (Design): tiny wording nit for the export acknowledgement: prefer 'Export started. We will email you when the file is ready.' if email is sent; otherwise 'Export started. You can check the Exports page for progress.'
enomar (Frontend): for now we show an in-app notification; will use 'Export started. You can view progress on the Exports page.'
ux-bot: reminder: update component spec 'Icon / Ellipsis button' and copy table in Figma.
tori (Design): will update Figma and the copy docs. tagging @sam for accessibility review on the new aria-live phrasing. :sparkles:
sam (a11y): will run a quick NVDA/VO pass once PR is up. also recommend an e2e that asserts the live region content after actions.
omar (Frontend): PR #4410 opened — standardizes ellipsis aria-labels, interpolates object name, adds aria-live updates for export/archive/delete flows. includes unit tests + cypress check.
tori (Design): thanks — will review and add screenshots to the copy doc. ship to canary when tests pass. :white_check_mark:
